// Compile-only contract for the additive SDK. NOT an implementation or a seed.
// Bodies intentionally fail behavior checks. Public signatures are normative.
package codingagent

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "time"
 agenttypes "github.com/minifish-org/pith/packages/agent/types"
 aitypes "github.com/minifish-org/pith/packages/ai/types"
)

// Batch configuration. Unknown JSON settings must survive load/save.
type Settings map[string]json.RawMessage
func LoadSettings(globalFile, projectFile string, overrides Settings) (Settings, error) { return nil,nil }
func SaveSettings(file string, settings Settings) error { return nil }
type ModelOptions struct {
 Model *aitypes.Model
 MaxTokens *int
 ContextWindow *int
 ThinkingLevel agenttypes.ThinkingLevel
 APIKey func(context.Context, string) (string,error)
 StreamFn agenttypes.StreamFn
}
func ResolveModel(options ModelOptions) (*aitypes.Model,error) { return nil,nil }

// Batch storage. Entries are an append-only tree; Branch changes the leaf.
// Payload can contain a message, compaction, model change or custom event.
type SessionEntry struct {
 ID string `json:"id"`
 ParentID string `json:"parentId,omitempty"`
 Type string `json:"type"`
 Payload json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`
}
type SessionManager struct{}
func OpenSession(file string) (*SessionManager,error) { return &SessionManager{},nil }
func (s *SessionManager) Append(kind string, payload json.RawMessage) (SessionEntry,error) { return SessionEntry{},nil }
func (s *SessionManager) Entries() []SessionEntry { return nil }
func (s *SessionManager) Context() []SessionEntry { return nil }
func (s *SessionManager) Branch(id string) error { return nil }
func (s *SessionManager) LeafID() string { return "" }
func (s *SessionManager) Close() error { return nil }

// Batch resources. Paths are explicit; never read the user's home implicitly.
type ResourceOptions struct { Cwd string; AgentDir string; SkillPaths []string; TemplatePaths []string; ContextFiles []string; SystemPrompt string; AppendSystemPrompt []string }
type Skill struct { Name, Description, File, Body string }
type PromptTemplate struct { Name, Description, File, Body string }
type ResourceSet struct { SystemPrompt string; Skills []Skill; Templates []PromptTemplate; ContextFiles []string; Diagnostics []string }
func LoadResources(options ResourceOptions) (ResourceSet,error) { return ResourceSet{},nil }
func ExpandTemplate(template PromptTemplate, args []string) (string,error) { return "",nil }

// Batch tools. Tools use existing Pi/Pith message types, not another protocol.
type ToolDefinition struct {
 Name, Description string
 Parameters json.RawMessage
 Execute func(context.Context, json.RawMessage) (ToolResult,error)
}
type ToolResult struct { Content []aitypes.ContentBlock; Details json.RawMessage; IsError bool }
type ToolCall struct { ID, Name string; Arguments json.RawMessage }
type ToolHooks struct {
 Before func(context.Context, ToolCall) error
 After func(context.Context, ToolCall, ToolResult) (ToolResult,error)
}
type ToolRegistry struct{}
func NewToolRegistry(cwd string, custom []ToolDefinition, allow, deny []string, hooks ToolHooks) (*ToolRegistry,error) { return &ToolRegistry{},nil }
func (r *ToolRegistry) Names() []string { return nil }
func (r *ToolRegistry) Execute(ctx context.Context, call ToolCall) (ToolResult,error) { return ToolResult{},nil }
func (r *ToolRegistry) SetActive(names []string) error { return nil }
func (r *ToolRegistry) Register(tool ToolDefinition) error { return nil }

// Batch session. No implicit per-run turn/time cap; callers own context budgets.
type SessionOptions struct {
 Cwd string
 Model ModelOptions
 Manager *SessionManager
 Resources ResourceOptions
 Tools *ToolRegistry
 Settings Settings
 Policy RunPolicy
}
type RunPolicy struct {
 MaxTurns int
 RetryAttempts int
 RetryDelay time.Duration
 CompactReserveTokens int
 KeepRecentMessages int
 Summarize func(context.Context, []agenttypes.AgentMessage) (string,error)
}
type SessionEvent struct { Type, ToolName, ToolCallID, Text string; IsError bool; Message *agenttypes.AgentMessage }
type RunResult struct { StopReason aitypes.StopReason; Turns int; Messages []agenttypes.AgentMessage; Usage aitypes.Usage }
type AgentSession struct{}
func CreateAgentSession(options SessionOptions) (*AgentSession,error) { return &AgentSession{},nil }
func (s *AgentSession) Prompt(ctx context.Context, text string) (RunResult,error) { return RunResult{},nil }
func (s *AgentSession) Subscribe(listener func(SessionEvent)) func() { return func(){} }
func (s *AgentSession) Messages() []agenttypes.AgentMessage { return nil }
func (s *AgentSession) SetModel(model ModelOptions) error { return nil }
func (s *AgentSession) SetActiveTools(names []string) error { return nil }
func (s *AgentSession) Steer(text string) error { return nil }
func (s *AgentSession) FollowUp(text string) error { return nil }
func (s *AgentSession) Abort() {}
func (s *AgentSession) Close() error { return nil }
func (s *AgentSession) Compact(ctx context.Context) error { return nil }
